events.title: Already Added the Demo? Try One Run and Share Your Feedback
events.summary: Already added the free demo? Before Steam Next Fest, please try one run and share your feedback. Explore the dark underground maze, find the keys, survive traps and enemies, and tell us what you think. Your feedback will help us improve Lost in the Dark Labyrinth and shape the final version. ːsteamthumbsupːComments are welcome here, or you can send feedback directly to: RFKimmersive@outlook.com Lost in the Dark Labyrinth is scheduled to launch on November 13, 2026.
